analysis:
Examined all supplied metadata, patches and source excerpts. SKILL.md head lines 10–16 removes the console-retention statement while retaining platform ownership and the restriction on live endpoint/hosting changes. Deleted hooks provided only console lint/build checks (.githooks/pre-commit base 16–27; pre-push base 35–54), not provider signing, authorization or runtime enforcement. Deleting .github/dependabot.yml removes the /console-ui dependency-update configuration (base 3–28). ci.yml removes the console routing lane (base 37) and npm install/lint/test/build job (base 638–658); the supplied patch does not alter read-only workflow permissions, release-integrity checks or the provider test gate (base 570–592).
Against the indexed assets and boundaries, these changes show no direct modification of attestation/build qualification (A-011/A-017, T-013/T-054), serving authorization (T-052/T-053), hop encryption (T-008), cache isolation/storage (T-041), billing, native inference or local hold/fan controls. Console lint and build removal alone does not establish an exploitable regression. The combined removal of console CI, hooks and dependency maintenance is material only if this repository retains an active console build/deployment dependency; that prerequisite is not established here. Integration should reconcile these removals with the PR's console retirement/migration and hosting changes, if any. This batch contains no console source, deployment configuration or replacement maintenance evidence, so that contract remains unresolved rather than a finding. Canonical context provides an index and selected details, not every definition in full.
